items.stem: Which of the following statements about enzymes is correct?

options.text: A denatured enzyme can resume its activity under optimum conditions.
The optimum temperature of most enzymes is 37 oC.
The activation energy of an enzyme-catalysed reaction is lower than that of the uncatalysed reaction.
Enzymes are made up of carbohydrates and proteins.

items.stem:
